quests.title: Aragaru's Drawing

dialogue.t: Golden Nara and White Floaty, you are here again!
Whoa! Say hello before jumping out next time! You scared Paimon again!

dialogue.sit: We chased the bad guys away for you.

dialogue.t: Hmph... You're right... So, Golden Nara and White Floaty who don't look like bad guys, could you do me a favor?
And Paimon is Paimon, don't forget that again!
We have been here with you, but you forgot it all... Ugh, too much explanation! {NICKNAME}, why don't we do that together?

dialogue.sit: You describe your adventure with Aragaru in detail.

dialogue.t: Is that so...? I can't remember, but I somehow want to believe you... And you have the flower I gave, I can feel her.
Ah, right! The bad Nara set up a campsite. Let's see what they left there. Maybe we could know their plans!
Let's go to the bad Nara's campsite and find out what they're up to!

dialogue.sit: How can you tell if someone's bad?

dialogue.t: Well, I can't really explain it, but Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are not baddies for sure! I believe that!
How is it? Did you find anything?
Hmm... Nothing but vague orders, and this! A dried flower!
Eh...! This flower, can I have it?
That's from the bad guys, aren't you afraid of getting poisoned... or something like that?
No need to worry, I have seen the flower before... The person, I should know... Please give it to me, okay?
Thank you! Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty!

dialogue.sit: Aragaru brought the little dried flower to Mawtiyima Forest...

quests.description: You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten…
